name: Composite commerce operations
description: The misleading_net_total_usd column is booked gross order value, before refunds. Money is USD. Order, customer, refund and line identifiers are unique only together with division_id. Business dates use America/New_York. Paid means the explicitly admitted order status vocabulary; posted means the independently admitted refund vocabulary. Unknown amounts stay unknown and must not be silently replaced with zero. Order-cohort and refund-activity net are different business definitions; an unspecified net question requires clarification. Customer segment NULL is a real grouping key. Only confirmed complete composite relationships may be used. Raw note values are private and never authoring evidence. Known-amount totals may sum known money only if their incompleteness is disclosed; definitive totals with unknown money require clarification. All-null sums remain NULL and a known zero remains zero.
